name: smwgraphics-32x32-sprites-pack
title: 32x32 Sprites Pack 3
description:
This is my third pack of 32x32 sprite graphics! Again, it's a bunch of sprites that have 2 walking frames, ready to reskin pretty much any 32x32 sprite out there. Autisticsceptile requested these as well, using them as graphics for the ultimate noob sprite. I'm gonna list them but you can just look at them below

- Elephant
- Wizard that looks like Wiz (Kirby and the Amazing Mirror)
- Little girl with temper issues (2 sprites, one normal the other angry)
- Alarm clock guy, similar to Mr. Tick Tock (Kirby as well)
- 2 mermaids (in separate files as they use different palettes)
- Anglerfish
- Weasel in the style of the Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
- Legged palm tree sort of similar to Exeggcutor (Pokémon)
- Some emperor dude supposed to look like Clovis (Code Geass)
- Tatanga (Super Mario Land)
- Fishperson
